method: derived from the K1 dossier; a row leaves primary navigation by its own disposition only when that disposition is RETIRE FROM PRIMARY NAVIGATION, MERGE, or MOVE INTO CHAT WIDGET

survivors.why: the conversation itself; every capability is reached by asking
who you are to this tenant - an identity surface, not a capability
which channels and providers are bound; a SOURCE_STATUS reconnect HANDOFFs here
the class-s destination for consent and erasure - the one place a consent decision can be made, because FR-6a forbids a widget from conferring it
delivery preferences, re-read at delivery time rather than at compose time

authorizedScope.note: this reproduces the authorized figure of 34 from the data. 89 pwa primary-nav entries, 50 removed by disposition, 39 still assigned, 39 - 5 = 34.

allMayaOwnedChannels.note: the authorized 34 is pwa-scoped and correct for that scope. Across every Maya-owned channel the figure is larger, because seven further entries live outside the pwa. They are listed so the owner sees the whole number, not only the one the ratchet was sized against.
